decisions.choice: el Hijo unigénito (L); su Hijo único (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:14 and 1:18: Literal may use "unigénito", which in today's Spanish means an only child; Balanced and Readable avoid it because "-génito" suggests "begotten" (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps "el Hijo"; Balanced and Readable add "su", as English adds "his".

decisions.choice: no se pierda (R); no perezca (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Perecer" is uncommon for young readers; "perderse" is how John uses the verb elsewhere (meaning decision m7).

decisions.choice: la gente del mundo ... así es como la amó
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says who the world is (meaning decision m3) and spells out "in this way".

decisions.choice: c'est ainsi que Dieu a aimé le monde : il a donné (L); tel a été l'amour de Dieu pour le monde qu'il a donné (B)
alternatives: Dieu a tant aimé le monde qu'il a donné
decisions.reason: Literal gives the sense of the adverb, "in this way" (meaning decision m2). Balanced uses "tel ... que", which, like English "such", can mean "of this kind" or "so great", and so keeps the question in m2 open; the familiar "tant aimé" leans to how much, and the footnote of m2 gives that reading. Readable says "voici comment".

decisions.choice: le Fils, l'unique (L); son Fils unique (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:14 and 1:18: the word means unique, the only one of his kind (meaning decision m4, whose footnote gives "only begotten"). Literal keeps the Greek order, with the adjective after the noun and its own article. Balanced and Readable say "son": the Son is God's.

decisions.choice: ne se perde pas (L); ne périsse pas (B); ne soient pas perdus (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to be lost or destroyed (meaning decision m7). Literal uses "se perdre", which keeps the middle voice of the Greek and the link with 6:39 and 10:28; Balanced keeps the weightier "périr"; Readable says "être perdu", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Con duy nhất" (L); "Con một" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Con một" is the everyday word for an only child and says "one and only" plainly; "Con độc sinh" is a Sino-Vietnamese term many readers no longer understand. Literal spells out "duy nhất" to keep the separate adjective of the Greek.

decisions.choice: "Con ấy" for "him" (the Son)
decisions.reason: In a sentence where "Ngài" has just been used of the Father, "Con ấy" makes plain that believing is in the Son.

decisions.choice: "이렇게" (in this way)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the Greek as the manner of God's love: it took the form of giving the Son. "이토록" (so much) would say only how great it was; "이렇게" points to the giving that follows.

decisions.choice: "하나뿐인 아들" (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: "독생자" is the traditional Sino-Korean term but is opaque to many readers today; "하나뿐인 아들" says "one and only, unique" plainly at every level.

decisions.choice: deste modo (L); foi tal que (B); foi assim que (R)
alternatives: amou o mundo de tal maneira que
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2 reads the adverb as "in this way": God's love took the form of giving the Son. "Amou tanto" says only how much; the familiar "de tal maneira" leans the same way for most readers. Balanced's "foi tal que" can be read as "of this kind" or "so great", as the English "such" can.

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ’ ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος δι’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not for sent the God the Son into the world so that he might judge the world, but so that may be saved the world through him.

en.L: For God did not send the Son into the world in order that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might judge the world, but in order that the world might be saved through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: For God sent the Son into the world, not to condemn the world, but so that through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the world might be saved.
en.R: God did not send {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son into the world to judge it guilty. He sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} so that the world could be saved through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque no envió Dios al Hijo al mundo para que juzgara al mundo, sino para que el mundo fuera salvado por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Porque Dios envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo al mundo, no para condenar al mundo, sino para que por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} el mundo sea salvado.
es.R: Dios no envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo al mundo para declararlo culpable. Lo envió para que el mundo pudiera ser salvado por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Car Dieu n’a pas envoyé le Fils dans le monde afin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge le monde, mais afin que le monde soit sauvé à travers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Car Dieu a envoyé le Fils dans le monde, non pour condamner le monde, mais pour que, par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, le monde soit sauvé.
fr.R: Dieu n’a pas envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils dans le monde pour le déclarer coupable. Il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé pour que le monde puisse être sauvé grâce à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu hakumtuma Mwana kuja ulimwenguni ili auhukumu ulimwengu, bali ili ulimwengu upate kuokolewa kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu alimtuma Mwana ulimwenguni, si ili auhukumu ulimwengu, bali ili kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ulimwengu uokolewe.
sw.R: Mungu hakumtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulimwenguni ili auhukumu kuwa na hatia. Alimtuma ili ulimwengu uweze kuokolewa kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

vi.L: Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã không sai Con vào thế gian để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử thế gian, nhưng để thế gian được cứu qua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời sai Con vào thế gian, không phải để kết án thế gian, nhưng để nhờ Con mà thế gian được cứu.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời không sai Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến thế gian để kết tội thế gian. Ngài sai Con đến để nhờ Con mà thế gian được cứu.

ko.L: 하나님께서 아들을 세상에 보내신 것은 세상을 심판하려는 것이 아니라, 세상이 그를 통하여 구원을 받게 하시려는 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 아들을 세상에 보내신 것은 세상을 정죄하려는 것이 아니라, 아들을 통해 세상이 구원받게 하시려는 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 아들을 세상에 보내신 것은 세상을 죄인으로 판결하려는 것이 아니었다. 아들을 통해 세상이 구원받게 하시려고 보내신 것이다.

pt.L: Pois Deus não enviou o Filho ao mundo para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} julgasse o mundo, mas para que o mundo fosse salvo por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.B: Pois Deus enviou o Filho ao mundo, não para condenar o mundo, mas para que o mundo fosse salvo por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Deus não enviou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho ao mundo para declarar o mundo culpado. Ele {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} enviou para que o mundo pudesse ser salvo por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: judge: pass sentence on, condemn
decisions.reason: Set against "be saved", the verb here means a judgment that goes against someone. Jesus does bring judgment (5:22, 27; 9:39), but it is not the purpose of his coming (12:47).

decisions.choice: the world: humanity, as in 3:16
decisions.reason: Key term. The word comes three times in one sentence: the whole world is the object of God's saving purpose.

decisions.choice: be saved through him: God saves, the Son is the one through whom
decisions.reason: The passive points to God as the one who saves; "through him" names the Son as the means. The Samaritans call Jesus "the Savior of the world" (4:42).

decisions.choice: sent: the Son comes on the Father's mission
decisions.reason: John often calls God "the one who sent me" (5:24; 6:38-39); the Son acts for the Father who sent him.

decisions.choice: condemn (B); judge it guilty (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "judge" so the word family of 3:17-19 can be seen; Balanced and Readable give its sense here (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: God sent the Son ..., not to condemn ..., but so that
alternatives: God did not send ... to condemn ..., but
decisions.reason: Balanced states what God did first and then its purpose.

decisions.choice: his Son
decisions.reason: As in 3:16.

decisions.choice: juzgar (L); condenar (B); declarar culpable (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal keeps "juzgar" so the word family of 3:17-19 can be seen; Balanced and Readable give its sense here (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: fuera salvado / sea salvado
decisions.reason: The passive points to God as the one who saves (meaning decision m3); "se salve" could suggest the world saves itself.

decisions.choice: kuhukumu at every level; kuhukumu kuwa na hatia (R)
decisions.reason: Swahili "kuhukumu" means both to judge and to condemn, like κρίνῃ, so it serves Literal and Balanced where the English needs "judge" and "condemn". Readable adds "kuwa na hatia" (guilty) where the English Readable says "judge it guilty". The same holds in verse 18.

source.text: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν οὐ κρίνεται· ὁ δὲ μὴ πιστεύων ἤδη κέκριται, ὅτι μὴ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ μονογενοῦς υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] believing in him not is judged; the [one] but not believing already has been judged, because not he has believed in the name of the only Son of the God.

en.L: The one who believes in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} is not judged; but the one who does not believe has already been judged, because {{gender:they have|he has}} not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
en.B: The one who believes in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} is not condemned, but the one who does not believe is condemned already, for not having believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
en.R: Anyone who believes in the Son is not judged guilty. But anyone who does not believe is judged guilty already, because {{gender:they have|he has}} not believed in God's one and only Son.

es.L: El que cree en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no es juzgado; pero el que no cree ya ha sido juzgado, porque no ha creído en el nombre del unigénito Hijo de Dios.
es.B: El que cree en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no es condenado, pero el que no cree ya está condenado, por no haber creído en el nombre del Hijo único de Dios.
es.R: Quien cree en el Hijo no es declarado culpable. Pero quien no cree ya ha sido declarado culpable, porque no ha creído en el Hijo único de Dios.

fr.L: Celui qui croit en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} n’est pas jugé ; mais celui qui ne croit pas a déjà été jugé, parce qu’il n’a pas cru dans le nom du Fils unique de Dieu.
fr.B: Celui qui croit en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} n’est pas condamné, mais celui qui ne croit pas est déjà condamné, pour ne pas avoir cru dans le nom du Fils unique de Dieu.
fr.R: Celui qui croit au Fils n’est pas déclaré coupable. Mais celui qui ne croit pas est déjà déclaré coupable, parce qu’il n’a pas cru au Fils unique de Dieu.

sw.L: Yule anayemwamini hahukumiwi; lakini yule asiyeamini tayari amehukumiwa, kwa sababu hajaliamini jina la Mwana wa pekee wa Mungu.
sw.B: Anayemwamini hahukumiwi. Lakini asiyeamini amehukumiwa tayari, kwa sababu hajaliamini jina la Mwana wa pekee wa Mungu.
sw.R: Kila anayemwamini Mwana hahukumiwi kuwa na hatia. Lakini asiyeamini amekwisha hukumiwa kuwa na hatia, kwa sababu hajamwamini Mwana wa pekee wa Mungu.

vi.L: Ai tin vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì không bị xét xử; nhưng ai không tin thì đã bị xét xử rồi, vì người ấy đã không tin vào danh của Con một của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Ai tin vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì không bị kết án, còn ai không tin thì đã bị kết án rồi, vì đã không tin vào danh Con một của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Ai tin vào Con thì không bị kết tội. Nhưng ai không tin thì đã bị kết tội rồi, vì người ấy không tin vào Con một của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그를 믿는 사람은 심판을 받지 않는다. 그러나 믿지 않는 사람은 이미 심판을 받았다. 하나님의 하나뿐인 아들의 이름을 믿지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그를 믿는 사람은 정죄를 받지 않는다. 그러나 믿지 않는 사람은 이미 정죄를 받았다. 하나님의 하나뿐인 아들의 이름을 믿지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 아들을 믿는 사람은 죄인으로 판결받지 않는다. 그러나 믿지 않는 사람은 이미 죄인으로 판결받았다. 하나님의 하나뿐인 아들을 믿지 않았기 때문이다.

pt.L: Quem crê {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} não é julgado; mas quem não crê já foi julgado, porque não creu no nome do Filho único de Deus.
pt.B: Quem crê {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} não é condenado, mas quem não crê já está condenado, por não ter crido no nome do Filho único de Deus.
pt.R: Quem acredita no Filho não é declarado culpado. Mas quem não acredita já é declarado culpado, porque não acreditou no Filho único de Deus.

alignments.target_span: of the one and only Son

decisions.choice: the verdict is already in place
alternatives: judgment only at the last day
decisions.reason: "Is not judged" is present, and "has already been judged" is perfect: a verdict given and still standing. John speaks of judgment now as well as at the last day (5:24; 12:31, 48).

decisions.choice: believe in the name: believe in the person
decisions.reason: The name stands for the person, as in 1:12 and 2:23.

decisions.choice: one and only
decisions.reason: As in 3:16.

decisions.choice: condemned (B); judged guilty (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:17.

decisions.choice: {{gender:they have|he has}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone who does not believe; inclusive default. Balanced needs no pronoun.

decisions.choice: the Son; God's one and only Son
decisions.reason: Readable names the Son and gives the sense of the idiom (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: condenado (B); declarado culpable (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:17.

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish needs no pronoun for the person who does not believe ("porque no ha creído"), so the sentence is already general and no setting applies.

decisions.choice: el Hijo; el Hijo único de Dios
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable names the Son and gives the sense of the idiom (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: croire dans le nom (L, B); croire au Fils (R, and 3:36)
decisions.reason: French cannot write "croire en le": before a noun with the definite article "croire en" becomes "croire au" or "croire dans le". Literal and Balanced use "croire dans le nom", which keeps the sense of believing in the person the name stands for (meaning decision m2); "croire au nom" could be heard as "croire à", believing that something is true (compare 2:22). Before a person, "croire au Fils" is the usual French for believing in him, so Readable uses it here, and Balanced and Readable in 3:36.

source.text: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ κρίσις ὅτι τὸ φῶς ἐλήλυθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον καὶ ἠγάπησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι μᾶλλον τὸ σκότος ἢ τὸ φῶς, ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν πονηρὰ τὰ ἔργα.

records.literal_gloss: This now is the judgment, that the light has come into the world and loved the people rather the darkness than the light, were for of them evil the works.

en.L: And this is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and {{gender:people|men}} loved rather the darkness than the light, for their works were evil.
en.B: And this is how the judgment falls: the light has come into the world, but {{gender:people|men}} loved the darkness more than the light, because the things they did were evil.
en.R: This is how the judging happens: The light has come into the world. But {{gender:people|men}} loved the darkness more than the light, because they were doing evil things.

es.L: Y este es el juicio: que la luz ha venido al mundo, y {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} amaron más la oscuridad que la luz, porque sus obras eran malas.
es.B: Y así es como se da el juicio: la luz ha venido al mundo, pero {{gender:la gente amó|los hombres amaron}} más la oscuridad que la luz, porque lo que hacían era malo.
es.R: Así es como sucede el juicio: la luz ha venido al mundo, pero {{gender:la gente amó|los hombres amaron}} más la oscuridad que la luz, porque hacían cosas malas.

fr.L: Or voici le jugement : la lumière est venue dans le monde, et {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} ont aimé les ténèbres plutôt que la lumière, car leurs œuvres étaient mauvaises.
fr.B: Et voici comment le jugement se produit : la lumière est venue dans le monde, mais {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} ont aimé les ténèbres plus que la lumière, parce que ce qu’ils faisaient était mauvais.
fr.R: Voici comment le jugement se passe : la lumière est venue dans le monde. Mais {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} ont aimé les ténèbres plus que la lumière, parce qu’ils faisaient le mal.

sw.L: Basi hukumu ni hii: nuru imekuja ulimwenguni, na watu wakalipenda giza zaidi kuliko nuru, kwa maana matendo yao yalikuwa mabaya.
sw.B: Na hivi ndivyo hukumu inavyokuja: nuru imekuja ulimwenguni, lakini watu walipenda giza kuliko nuru, kwa sababu mambo waliyokuwa wakifanya yalikuwa mabaya.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo hukumu inavyotokea: Nuru imekuja ulimwenguni. Lakini watu walipenda giza kuliko nuru, kwa sababu walikuwa wakitenda mambo maovu.

vi.L: Và đây là sự xét xử: ánh sáng đã đến thế gian, và người ta đã yêu bóng tối hơn ánh sáng, vì việc làm của họ là xấu ác.
vi.B: Và sự xét xử là thế này: ánh sáng đã đến thế gian, nhưng người ta lại yêu bóng tối hơn ánh sáng, vì những việc họ làm là xấu xa.
vi.R: Việc xét xử diễn ra như thế này: Ánh sáng đã đến thế gian, nhưng người ta yêu bóng tối hơn ánh sáng, vì họ đang làm những việc xấu xa.

ko.L: 그리고 심판은 이것이다. 빛이 세상에 왔는데, 사람들이 빛보다 어둠을 더 사랑했다는 것이다. 그들의 행위가 악했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 심판은 이렇게 이루어진다. 빛이 세상에 왔지만, 사람들은 빛보다 어둠을 더 사랑했다. 그들이 하는 일이 악했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 심판은 이렇게 일어난다. 빛이 세상에 왔다. 그런데 사람들은 빛보다 어둠을 더 사랑했다. 그들이 나쁜 일을 하고 있었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E este é o julgamento: que a luz veio ao mundo, e {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} amaram mais as trevas do que a luz, pois as suas obras eram más.
pt.B: E é assim que se dá o julgamento: a luz veio ao mundo, mas {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} amaram mais as trevas do que a luz, porque o que faziam era mau.
pt.R: É assim que acontece o julgamento: a luz veio ao mundo. Mas {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} amaram mais a escuridão do que a luz, porque estavam fazendo coisas más.

decisions.choice: the judgment: what the judgment consists of
decisions.reason: The sentence says what judgment is: the light has come, and people choose the darkness. The verdict is passed in their own response to the light (3:18).

decisions.choice: the light: Jesus, the light of 1:4-9
decisions.reason: "The true light ... was coming into the world" (1:9). Jesus calls himself the light of the world (8:12; 9:5; 12:46).

decisions.choice: people, men and women
decisions.reason: The word is general here, so the gender setting applies.

decisions.choice: loved: the same verb as God's love in 3:16
decisions.reason: God loved the world; the world loved the darkness. The choice shows what people love.

decisions.choice: their works were evil: the reason they preferred darkness
decisions.reason: What people do shapes what they love: those who do evil stay away from the light (the next verse).

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: Inclusive default; the traditional form one tap away.

decisions.choice: more than
decisions.reason: Plain comparison.

decisions.choice: how the judgment falls (B); how the judging happens (R)
decisions.reason: Shows that the sentence describes what judgment is (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} (L); {{gender:la gente amó|los hombres amaron}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: People in general (meaning decision m3): inclusive default, traditional one tap away. The span takes in the verb where the subject changes number.

decisions.choice: la oscuridad
decisions.reason: The same word as in 1:5, so the link with the opening can be seen. "Las tinieblas" is the traditional word but now sounds literary.

decisions.choice: ont aimé ... plutôt que / plus que
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of God's love in 3:16 (meaning decision m4). "Préférer" would be smoother French but would hide the contrast John draws: God loved the world, and people loved the darkness. "Les ténèbres" is kept at every level, Readable included, as the word of 1:5.

source.text: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ φαῦλα πράσσων μισεῖ τὸ φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα μὴ ἐλεγχθῇ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Everyone for the [one] evil things practicing hates the light and not comes to the light, so that not may be exposed the works of him;

en.L: For everyone who practices evil [things] hates the light and does not come to the light, in order that {{gender:their|his}} works may not be exposed.
en.B: For anyone who does what is wrong hates the light and will not come near it, so that what {{gender:they do|he does}} will not be exposed.
en.R: People who do evil hate the light. They stay away from it so that the bad things they do will not be seen for what they are.

es.L: Porque todo el que practica lo malo odia la luz y no viene a la luz, para que sus obras no sean expuestas.
es.B: Porque todo el que hace el mal odia la luz y no se acerca a ella, para que lo que hace no quede al descubierto.
es.R: Los que hacen el mal odian la luz. Se mantienen lejos de ella para que no se vea lo malo que hacen.

fr.L: Car quiconque pratique le mal hait la lumière et ne vient pas à la lumière, afin que ses œuvres ne soient pas dévoilées.
fr.B: Car quiconque fait ce qui est mal déteste la lumière et ne s’en approche pas, de peur que ce qu’il fait ne soit mis au jour.
fr.R: Ceux qui font le mal détestent la lumière. Ils restent loin d’elle pour que le mal qu’ils font ne soit pas vu pour ce qu’il est.

sw.L: Kwa kuwa kila anayefanya maovu anaichukia nuru, wala haji kwenye nuru, ili matendo yake yasifichuliwe.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mtu anayetenda mabaya huichukia nuru, wala hataki kuikaribia, ili mambo anayoyatenda yasifichuliwe.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda maovu huichukia nuru. Huikwepa nuru ili mambo mabaya wanayoyafanya yasionekane jinsi yalivyo.

vi.L: Vì hễ ai làm điều ác thì ghét ánh sáng và không đến với ánh sáng, để việc làm của mình không bị phơi bày.
vi.B: Vì ai làm điều sai trái thì ghét ánh sáng và không chịu đến gần ánh sáng, để những việc mình làm khỏi bị phơi bày.
vi.R: Người làm điều ác thì ghét ánh sáng. Họ tránh xa ánh sáng để những việc xấu họ làm không bị lộ ra cho mọi người thấy.

ko.L: 악한 일을 행하는 사람은 누구나 빛을 미워하고 빛으로 오지 않기 때문이다. 자기 행위가 드러나지 않게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: 잘못된 일을 하는 사람은 누구나 빛을 미워하고 빛 가까이 오지 않는다. 자기가 한 일이 드러날까 봐서이다.
ko.R: 나쁜 일을 하는 사람들은 빛을 미워한다. 그들은 빛을 피한다. 자기들이 하는 나쁜 일이 다 드러날까 봐 그러는 것이다.

pt.L: Pois todo aquele que pratica o mal odeia a luz e não vem para a luz, para que as suas obras não sejam expostas.
pt.B: Pois quem faz o que é mau odeia a luz e não se aproxima dela, para que o que faz não seja exposto.
pt.R: As pessoas que fazem o mal odeiam a luz. Elas ficam longe dela para que as coisas más que fazem não sejam vistas como realmente são.

decisions.choice: evil things: worthless, wicked deeds
decisions.reason: φαῦλα is a broad word for what is bad or worthless; it is set against "doing the truth" in the next verse (compare 5:29).

decisions.choice: exposed: brought to light and shown to be wrong
decisions.reason: The verb means to expose and convict, as in 8:46 and 16:8. Light shows deeds for what they are.

decisions.choice: everyone: anyone at all, man or woman
decisions.reason: The statement is general, so the gender setting applies.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:they do|he does}}
decisions.reason: Inclusive default. Readable uses the plural and needs no setting.

decisions.choice: They stay away from it
alternatives: does not come to the light
decisions.reason: Plain words for not coming to the light.

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Todo el que" and "sus obras" are general in Spanish, with no pronoun to choose, so no setting applies here or in 3:21.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα φανερωθῇ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ὅτι ἐν θεῷ ἐστιν εἰργασμένα.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] but doing the truth comes to the light, so that may be revealed his the works that in God they are having been done.

en.L: But the one who does the truth comes to the light, in order that {{gender:their|his}} works may be revealed, that they have been done in God."
en.B: But whoever practices the truth comes to the light, so that it may become plain that {{gender:their|his}} deeds have been done in God."
en.R: But anyone who lives by the truth comes to the light. Then it becomes clear that what {{gender:they have|he has}} done was done in union with God."

es.L: Pero el que hace la verdad viene a la luz, para que sus obras sean manifestadas, que han sido hechas en Dios».
es.B: Pero el que practica la verdad viene a la luz, para que se vea claramente que sus obras han sido hechas en Dios».
es.R: Pero quien vive según la verdad se acerca a la luz. Así se ve claramente que lo que ha hecho, lo ha hecho unido a Dios».

fr.L: Mais celui qui fait la vérité vient à la lumière, afin que ses œuvres soient manifestées : elles ont été faites en Dieu. »
fr.B: Mais celui qui met la vérité en pratique vient à la lumière, pour qu’il apparaisse clairement que ses actes ont été accomplis en Dieu. »
fr.R: Mais celui qui vit selon la vérité s’approche de la lumière. Alors on voit bien que ce qu’il a fait, il l’a fait uni à Dieu. »

sw.L: Lakini anayeitenda kweli anakuja kwenye nuru, ili matendo yake yaonekane wazi kwamba yametendwa ndani ya Mungu."
sw.B: Lakini yeyote anayeitenda kweli huja kwenye nuru, ili ionekane wazi kwamba matendo yake yamefanywa ndani ya Mungu."
sw.R: Lakini mtu anayeishi kwa kufuata kweli huja kwenye nuru. Ndipo inaonekana wazi kwamba aliyoyafanya aliyafanya akiwa ameungana na Mungu."

vi.L: Nhưng ai làm chân lý thì đến với ánh sáng, để việc làm của người ấy được bày tỏ ra, rằng chúng đã được làm trong Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.B: Còn ai thực hành chân lý thì đến với ánh sáng, để thấy rõ rằng những việc người ấy làm đều đã được làm trong Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Còn ai sống theo chân lý thì đến với ánh sáng. Khi đó, mọi người thấy rõ những việc người ấy làm là được làm trong sự gắn bó với Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 그러나 진리를 행하는 사람은 빛으로 온다. 자기 행위가 하나님 안에서 행해진 것임이 나타나게 하려는 것이다."
ko.B: 그러나 진리를 실천하는 사람은 빛으로 나아온다. 자기가 한 일들이 하나님 안에서 이루어졌다는 것이 환히 드러나게 하려는 것이다."
ko.R: 그러나 진리대로 사는 사람은 빛으로 나온다. 그러면 그 사람이 한 일이 하나님과 하나 되어 한 일이라는 것이 분명히 드러난다."

pt.L: Mas quem faz a verdade vem para a luz, para que as suas obras sejam manifestadas, que foram feitas em Deus."
pt.B: Mas quem pratica a verdade vem para a luz, para que fique claro que o que faz foi feito em Deus."
pt.R: Mas quem vive de acordo com a verdade vem para a luz. Então fica claro que o que fez foi feito em união com Deus."

decisions.choice: do the truth: act faithfully, live by what is true
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of speaking: to "do truth" is to act faithfully (Genesis 47:29; Nehemiah 9:33). 1 John 1:6 uses it the same way. It is the opposite of doing evil (3:20).

decisions.choice: done in God: done in fellowship with God, by his working
alternatives: done in the sight of God
decisions.reason: "In God" in John describes a life lived in union with God (14:10, 20; 17:21). Such deeds come from God, so the one who does them is not afraid to have them seen.

decisions.choice: revealed: made visible
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 1:31 and 2:11, where Jesus and his glory are revealed.

decisions.choice: Jesus's words end here
decisions.reason: See meaning decision m1 at 3:16.

decisions.choice: practices the truth (B); lives by the truth (R)
decisions.reason: "Do the truth" is not natural English; Balanced and Readable keep the key term "truth" and say what the idiom means (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: in union with God
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in God" means (meaning decision m2). It is one way of filling out a short phrase.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:they have|he has}}
decisions.reason: As in 3:20.

decisions.choice: practica la verdad (B); vive según la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "hacer la verdad" is not natural Spanish; Balanced and Readable keep "verdad" and say what the idiom means (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: unido a Dios
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says what "in God" means (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: a colon before "elles ont été faites en Dieu"
alternatives: que ses œuvres soient manifestées, qu'elles ont été faites en Dieu
decisions.reason: The Greek joins the last clause with "that", which says what will be made plain about the deeds. French cannot hang a second "que" on "soient manifestées", so Literal uses a colon, which does the same work. "Manifester" is the verb used for the same Greek word in 1:31 and 2:11 (meaning decision m3).

source.text: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν γῆν, καὶ ἐκεῖ διέτριβεν μετ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβάπτιζεν.

records.literal_gloss: After these things came the Jesus and the disciples of him into the Judean land, and there he was staying with them and was baptizing.

en.L: After these things Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples came into the land of Judea, and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was spending time with them and baptizing.
en.B: After this, Jesus went with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples into the Judean countryside. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stayed with them for a while and baptized people.
en.R: After that, Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples left Jerusalem and went out into the countryside of Judea. Jesus stayed there with them for a while and baptized people.

es.L: Después de estas cosas, vinieron Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos a la tierra de Judea, y allí pasaba tiempo con ellos y bautizaba.
es.B: Después de esto, Jesús fue con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos a la región de Judea. Allí pasó un tiempo con ellos y bautizaba a la gente.
es.R: Después, Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos salieron de Jerusalén y fueron al campo de Judea. Jesús pasó allí un tiempo con ellos y bautizaba a la gente.

fr.L: Après ces choses, Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples vinrent dans le pays de Judée, et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} séjournait avec eux et baptisait.
fr.B: Après cela, Jésus se rendit avec {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples dans les campagnes de Judée. Il y passa quelque temps avec eux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} baptisait.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples ont quitté Jérusalem et sont allés dans la campagne de Judée. Jésus est resté là quelque temps avec eux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} baptisait des gens.

sw.L: Baada ya mambo haya Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuja katika nchi ya Uyahudi, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} alikuwa akikaa nao huko na kubatiza.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo, Yesu alikwenda pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika maeneo ya vijijini ya Uyahudi. Akakaa nao huko kwa muda, akawabatiza watu.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waliondoka Yerusalemu, wakaenda mashambani mwa Uyahudi. Yesu alikaa nao huko kwa muda, akawabatiza watu.

vi.L: Sau những việc này, Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến miền đất Giu-đê, và tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lưu lại với họ và làm báp-têm.
vi.B: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu cùng các môn đồ đi đến vùng quê Giu-đê. Ngài ở lại đó với họ một thời gian và làm báp-têm cho người ta.
vi.R: Sau đó, Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ rời Giê-ru-sa-lem, đi về vùng thôn quê xứ Giu-đê. Ngài ở đó với họ một thời gian và làm báp-têm cho dân chúng.

ko.L: 이 일들 후에 예수께서 그분의 제자들과 함께 유대 땅으로 가셨다. 그리고 거기서 그들과 함께 머무르시며 세례를 주고 계셨다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 예수께서는 제자들과 함께 유대 지방으로 가셨다. 그곳에서 그들과 함께 얼마 동안 지내시며 사람들에게 세례를 주셨다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 예수께서는 제자들과 함께 예루살렘을 떠나 유대 시골 지역으로 가셨다. 예수께서는 거기서 제자들과 함께 얼마 동안 지내시면서 사람들에게 세례를 주셨다.

pt.L: Depois dessas coisas, Jesus e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos foram para a terra da Judeia, e ali {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} passava tempo com eles e batizava.
pt.B: Depois disso, Jesus foi com os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos para a região da Judeia. Ali {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ficou com eles por algum tempo e batizava.
pt.R: Depois disso, Jesus e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos saíram de Jerusalém e foram para o interior da Judeia. Jesus ficou ali com eles por algum tempo e batizava as pessoas.

decisions.choice: the Judean land: the countryside of Judea, outside Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Jesus had been in Jerusalem, the chief city of Judea (2:23). Now he goes out into the surrounding region, toward the Jordan, where John was also baptizing.

decisions.choice: he was baptizing: through his disciples, as 4:2 explains
decisions.reason: The imperfect describes an activity that went on for a time. John adds in 4:2 that Jesus himself did not baptize, but his disciples did; what they did is counted as his work.

decisions.choice: stayed, spent time
decisions.reason: The verb means to pass time somewhere; it is not the word "remain" of 1:38-39.

decisions.choice: left Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable says where they came from (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: pasar tiempo
decisions.reason: This is not the verb "remain" (meaning decision m3), so Spanish avoids "quedarse", which this translation uses for that verb in 1:38-39.

decisions.choice: salieron de Jerusalén
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says where they came from (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: séjournait (L); passa quelque temps (B); est resté quelque temps (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to spend time somewhere, not the "demeurer" of 1:38-39 (meaning decision m3), so French keeps "demeurer" for that word and uses the ordinary words for a stay here.

decisions.choice: "làm báp-têm" for baptize (whole book)
decisions.reason: "Làm báp-têm" is the Protestant word; "rửa tội" and "làm phép rửa" are Catholic. It follows the tradition the style guide takes for names and key terms.

source.text: ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων ἐν Αἰνὼν ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ, ὅτι ὕδατα πολλὰ ἦν ἐκεῖ, καὶ παρεγίνοντο καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο·

records.literal_gloss: Was now also the John baptizing in Aenon near the Salim, because waters many were there, and they were coming and were being baptized;

en.L: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there were many waters there, and [people] were coming and being baptized.
en.B: John too was baptizing, at Aenon near Salim, where there was plenty of water, and people kept coming to be baptized.
en.R: John was also baptizing people at a place called Aenon, near the town of Salim. There was plenty of water there, and people kept coming to John to be baptized.

es.L: Y también Juan estaba bautizando en Enón, cerca de Salim, porque había allí muchas aguas, y venían y eran bautizados.
es.B: Juan también estaba bautizando, en Enón, cerca de Salim, donde había mucha agua, y la gente seguía llegando para ser bautizada.
es.R: Juan también bautizaba a la gente en un lugar llamado Enón, cerca del pueblo de Salim. Allí había mucha agua, y muchos seguían yendo a Juan para que los bautizara.

fr.L: Or Jean aussi baptisait à Énon, près de Salim, parce qu’il y avait là des eaux abondantes, et [les gens] venaient et étaient baptisés.
fr.B: Jean, lui aussi, baptisait, à Énon près de Salim, où l’eau était abondante ; et les gens continuaient de venir se faire baptiser.
fr.R: Jean aussi baptisait des gens, à un endroit appelé Énon, tout près de Salim. Il y avait beaucoup d’eau à cet endroit, et les gens continuaient à venir trouver Jean pour être baptisés.

sw.L: Na Yohana pia alikuwa akibatiza katika Ainoni karibu na Salimu, kwa maana palikuwa na maji mengi hapo, na [watu] walikuwa wakifika na kubatizwa.
sw.B: Yohana pia alikuwa akibatiza huko Ainoni karibu na Salimu, mahali palipokuwa na maji ya kutosha, na watu waliendelea kuja kubatizwa.
sw.R: Yohana naye alikuwa akiwabatiza watu mahali palipoitwa Ainoni, karibu na mji wa Salimu. Huko kulikuwa na maji mengi, na watu waliendelea kumjia Yohana ili wabatizwe.

vi.L: Và Giăng cũng đang làm báp-têm tại Ê-nôn, gần Sa-lim, vì ở đó có nhiều nước, và [người ta] cứ đến và chịu báp-têm.
vi.B: Giăng cũng làm báp-têm tại Ê-nôn, gần Sa-lim, nơi có nhiều nước, và người ta cứ kéo đến để chịu báp-têm.
vi.R: Giăng cũng làm báp-têm cho dân chúng ở một nơi gọi là Ê-nôn, gần thị trấn Sa-lim. Ở đó có nhiều nước, và người ta cứ kéo đến với Giăng để chịu báp-têm.

ko.L: 그리고 요한도 살렘 가까이에 있는 애논에서 세례를 주고 있었다. 그곳에 물이 많았기 때문이다. 그리고 [사람들이] 와서 세례를 받고 있었다.
ko.B: 요한도 살렘 가까운 애논에서 세례를 주고 있었다. 그곳에는 물이 많아서, 사람들이 계속 와서 세례를 받았다.
ko.R: 요한도 살렘이라는 마을 가까이에 있는 애논이라는 곳에서 사람들에게 세례를 주고 있었다. 그곳에는 물이 많았다. 그래서 사람들이 계속 요한에게 와서 세례를 받았다.

pt.L: Ora, João também estava batizando em Enom, perto de Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas, e [as pessoas] vinham e eram batizadas.
pt.B: João também estava batizando, em Enom, perto de Salim, onde havia muita água, e as pessoas continuavam vindo para ser batizadas.
pt.R: João também estava batizando as pessoas num lugar chamado Enom, perto da cidade de Salim. Havia muita água ali, e as pessoas continuavam vindo até João para ser batizadas.

decisions.choice: Aenon near Salim: a place whose exact site is not known
decisions.reason: Aenon means "springs". In the early 300s Eusebius placed it in the Jordan valley about eight Roman miles south of Scythopolis (Beth-shan), near Salim. Another suggestion is in Samaria, east of Shechem, where there is a Salim and springs nearby. The translation does not depend on it.

decisions.choice: many waters: springs or streams, plenty of water for immersion
decisions.reason: The plural suggests several springs; John baptized by immersion, so he needed a good supply.

decisions.choice: people kept coming: the imperfects describe a continuing stream
decisions.reason: No subject is named; the people came and were baptized over a period of time.

decisions.choice: [people]
decisions.reason: English needs a subject for "were coming" (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: a place called ... the town of
decisions.reason: Readable says that these are place names.

decisions.choice: venían y eran bautizados, no supplied subject
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, as the Greek does, so Literal needs no bracketed "[people]" (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: un lugar llamado ... el pueblo de
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says that these are place names.

decisions.choice: Énon, Salim
decisions.reason: "Énon" is the usual French form of the name, which means "springs" (meaning decision m1). A reviewer should confirm it against the project's list of names.

source.text: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν βεβλημένος εἰς τὴν φυλακὴν ὁ Ἰωάννης.

records.literal_gloss: Not yet for had been thrown into the prison the John.

en.L: For John had not yet been thrown into prison.
en.B: This was before John had been put in prison.
en.R: This was before John was put in prison.

es.L: Porque Juan todavía no había sido echado en la cárcel.
es.B: Esto sucedió antes de que Juan fuera encarcelado.
es.R: Esto pasó antes de que metieran a Juan en la cárcel.

fr.L: Car Jean n’avait pas encore été jeté en prison.
fr.B: C’était avant que Jean soit mis en prison.
fr.R: Cela se passait avant que Jean soit mis en prison.

sw.L: Kwa maana Yohana alikuwa bado hajatupwa gerezani.
sw.B: Hii ilikuwa kabla Yohana hajatiwa gerezani.
sw.R: Hii ilikuwa kabla Yohana hajafungwa gerezani.

vi.L: Vì Giăng chưa bị bỏ vào ngục.
vi.B: Lúc ấy Giăng chưa bị bắt bỏ tù.
vi.R: Việc này xảy ra trước khi Giăng bị bỏ tù.

ko.L: 이는 요한이 아직 감옥에 갇히지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이것은 요한이 감옥에 갇히기 전의 일이다.
ko.R: 이때는 요한이 아직 감옥에 갇히기 전이었다.

pt.L: Pois João ainda não tinha sido lançado na prisão.
pt.B: Isso foi antes de João ser posto na prisão.
pt.R: Isso foi antes de João ser preso.

decisions.choice: John's imprisonment by Herod Antipas
decisions.reason: Herod Antipas, ruler of Galilee and Perea, imprisoned John and later had him put to death (Mark 6:17-29); the Jewish historian Josephus also tells of it (Antiquities 18.116-119). John's Gospel does not tell the story.

decisions.choice: an aside that places these events in time
decisions.reason: Mark 1:14 has Jesus begin preaching in Galilee after John was arrested. This remark shows that the time when both were baptizing came earlier.

decisions.choice: This was before John was put in prison
alternatives: For John had not yet been thrown into prison
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the point of the aside plainly.

source.text: Ἐγένετο οὖν ζήτησις ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν Ἰωάννου μετὰ Ἰουδαίου περὶ καθαρισμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Arose then a dispute from the disciples of John with a Jew about purification.

en.L: So a dispute arose on the part of John's disciples with a Jew about purification.
en.B: Then a dispute broke out between some of John's disciples and a Jewish man about ritual cleansing.
en.R: Some of John's disciples began to argue with a Jewish man about the washings that made people clean for worship.

es.L: Surgió, pues, una discusión de parte de los discípulos de Juan con un judío acerca de la purificación.
es.B: Entonces se produjo una discusión entre algunos discípulos de Juan y un judío sobre los ritos de purificación.
es.R: Algunos discípulos de Juan comenzaron a discutir con un judío sobre las ceremonias de lavado que purificaban a la gente para el culto.

fr.L: Il y eut donc une discussion de la part des disciples de Jean avec un Juif au sujet de la purification.
fr.B: Une discussion s’éleva alors entre des disciples de Jean et un Juif au sujet des purifications rituelles.
fr.R: Des disciples de Jean ont commencé à se disputer avec un Juif à propos des lavages qui rendaient les gens purs pour le culte.

sw.L: Basi kukatokea mabishano kati ya wanafunzi wa Yohana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu utakaso.
sw.B: Kisha baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yohana walianza kubishana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu desturi za kutakasa.
sw.R: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yohana walianza kubishana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu kunawa kunakomfanya mtu kuwa safi kwa ajili ya ibada.

vi.L: Vậy có một cuộc tranh luận nảy ra từ phía các môn đồ của Giăng với một người Do Thái về sự thanh tẩy.
vi.B: Bấy giờ, giữa một vài môn đồ của Giăng và một người Do Thái nổ ra cuộc tranh luận về việc tẩy uế theo nghi lễ.
vi.R: Một vài môn đồ của Giăng bắt đầu tranh cãi với một người Do Thái về việc tắm rửa theo nghi lễ để được sạch mà thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그런데 요한의 제자들 쪽에서 한 유대인과 정결에 관하여 논쟁이 일어났다.
ko.B: 그때 요한의 제자들 몇 사람과 어떤 유대인 사이에 정결 예식에 관한 논쟁이 벌어졌다.
ko.R: 요한의 제자들 몇 사람이 어떤 유대인과, 하나님을 예배하기 위해 몸을 깨끗하게 씻는 예식에 대해 말다툼을 하기 시작했다.

pt.L: Surgiu então uma discussão da parte dos discípulos de João com um judeu a respeito da purificação.
pt.B: Então surgiu uma discussão entre alguns discípulos de João e um judeu sobre a purificação ritual.
pt.R: Alguns discípulos de João começaram a discutir com um judeu sobre as lavagens que deixavam as pessoas puras para o culto.

decisions.choice: a Jew (singular, SBLGNT)
alternatives: Jews, or the Jews (plural, some early manuscripts)
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts, including Codex Vaticanus and the papyrus P75, have the singular. Some early witnesses, among them the papyrus P66 and the first hand of Codex Sinaiticus, have the plural. A single unnamed Jew is the less expected reading, which scribes were more likely to change. The footnote gives the plural. A reviewer should check this note against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a Jew: a Jewish man, not the authorities
decisions.reason: Here the word names one person, a Jewish man whose name is not given. John's disciples are Jews too; the dispute is among Jews about a Jewish practice.

decisions.choice: purification: ritual cleansing
decisions.reason: The same word as in 2:6, the purification for which the stone jars stood ready. The dispute was most likely about the value of baptism, John's or Jesus's, compared with other washings, since the next verse turns to Jesus's baptizing.

decisions.choice: a dispute, a debate
decisions.reason: The word means an inquiry or debate; here it is an argument.

decisions.choice: a Jewish man
decisions.reason: Shows that one person is meant (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: some of John's disciples
decisions.reason: The preposition "from" means the dispute started among John's disciples; not all of them need be meant.

decisions.choice: ritual cleansing (B); the washings that made people clean for worship (R)
decisions.reason: Says what kind of purification is meant (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: un judío
decisions.reason: One Jewish man (meaning decision m2); the singular already says so in Spanish, and no level speaks of leaders.

decisions.choice: los ritos de purificación (B); las ceremonias de lavado que purificaban a la gente para el culto (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: says what kind of purification is meant (meaning decision m3); the same word as the "purificación" of 2:6.

decisions.choice: un Juif
alternatives: un homme juif (B, R), as the English
decisions.reason: Here the word names one Jewish man (meaning decision m2), not the authorities. In French the singular "un Juif" already shows that one person is meant, so Balanced and Readable need no "homme". The plural reading is in the footnote of m1. Balanced "purifications rituelles" is the phrase used for the stone jars in 2:6 (m3).

source.text: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ῥαββί, ὃς ἦν μετὰ σοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ᾧ σὺ μεμαρτύρηκας, ἴδε οὗτος βαπτίζει καὶ πάντες ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And they came to the John and said to him, "Rabbi, [he] who was with you across the Jordan, to whom you have testified, look, this one baptizes and all are coming to him."

en.L: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, [the one] who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, look, this one is baptizing, and all are coming to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the one you testified about: look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is baptizing, and everyone is going to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: So they came to John and said, "Rabbi, remember the man who was with you on the east side of the Jordan River? You told everyone about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is baptizing people, and everyone is going to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} instead!"

es.L: Y vinieron a Juan y le dijeron: «Rabí, [aquel] que estaba contigo al otro lado del Jordán, de quien tú has dado testimonio, mira, este bautiza, y todos van a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.B: Fueron a ver a Juan y le dijeron: «Rabí, el que estaba contigo al otro lado del Jordán, aquel de quien diste testimonio: mira, ahora bautiza, y todos acuden a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.R: Entonces fueron a ver a Juan y le dijeron: «Rabí, ¿te acuerdas del hombre que estaba contigo al este del río Jordán? Tú hablaste a todos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡Pues ahora {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está bautizando a la gente, y todos van a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en lugar de venir a ti!».

fr.L: Et ils vinrent vers Jean et lui dirent : « Rabbi, [celui] qui était avec toi de l’autre côté du Jourdain, à qui tu as rendu témoignage, voici que celui-ci baptise, et tous vont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Ils allèrent trouver Jean et lui dirent : « Rabbi, l’homme qui était avec toi de l’autre côté du Jourdain, celui à qui tu as rendu témoignage, voilà qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} baptise, et tout le monde va vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.R: Alors ils sont allés voir Jean et lui ont dit : « Rabbi, tu te souviens de l’homme qui était avec toi sur la rive est du Jourdain ? Tu as parlé de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à tout le monde. Maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} baptise des gens, et tout le monde va vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} au lieu de venir à toi ! »

sw.L: Nao wakamwendea Yohana, wakamwambia, "Rabi, [yule] aliyekuwa pamoja nawe ng'ambo ya Yordani, ambaye wewe ulimshuhudia, tazama, huyu anabatiza, na wote wanakwenda {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}."
sw.B: Wakamwendea Yohana, wakamwambia, "Rabi, yule mtu aliyekuwa pamoja nawe ng'ambo ya Yordani, yule uliyemshuhudia: tazama, anabatiza, na kila mtu anakwenda {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}."
sw.R: Basi wakamwendea Yohana, wakamwambia, "Rabi, unamkumbuka yule mtu aliyekuwa pamoja nawe upande wa mashariki wa Mto Yordani? Uliwaambia watu wote habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Sasa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anabatiza watu, na kila mtu anakwenda {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} badala yako!"

vi.L: Và họ đến với Giăng và nói với ông: "Thưa Ra-bi, [người] đã ở với thầy bên kia [sông] Giô-đanh, người mà thầy đã làm chứng cho, kìa, người ấy đang làm báp-têm, và mọi người đều đến với ông ấy."
vi.B: Họ đến gặp Giăng và nói: "Thưa Ra-bi, người đã ở với thầy bên kia sông Giô-đanh, người được thầy làm chứng cho: kìa, ông ấy đang làm báp-têm, và ai nấy đều đến với ông ấy."
vi.R: Vậy họ đến nói với Giăng: "Thưa Ra-bi, thầy còn nhớ người đã ở với thầy ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh không? Thầy đã nói cho mọi người biết về ông ấy. Bây giờ ông ấy đang làm báp-têm, và ai cũng kéo đến với ông ấy thay vì đến với thầy!"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 요한에게 와서 그에게 말했다. "랍비, 요단강 건너편에서 선생님과 함께 있던 이, 선생님께서 증언하신 그 사람, 보십시오, 그가 세례를 주고 있고, 모든 사람이 그에게로 갑니다."
ko.B: 그들이 요한에게 와서 말했다. "랍비님, 요단강 건너편에서 선생님과 함께 있던 사람, 선생님께서 증언하신 그 사람 말입니다. 보십시오, 그 사람이 세례를 주고 있고, 모두 그에게로 가고 있습니다."
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 요한에게 가서 말했다. "랍비님, 요단강 동쪽에서 선생님과 함께 있던 사람을 기억하시지요? 선생님께서 그 사람에 대해 증언하셨지요. 그런데 지금 그 사람이 세례를 주고 있고, 사람들이 다 선생님 대신 그 사람에게로 가고 있습니다!"

pt.L: E vieram a João e lhe disseram: "Rabi, aquele que estava com o senhor do outro lado do Jordão, de quem o senhor deu testemunho, veja, este está batizando, e todos vão até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.B: Eles vieram a João e lhe disseram: "Rabi, o homem que estava com o senhor do outro lado do Jordão, aquele de quem o senhor deu testemunho: veja, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está batizando, e todo mundo está indo até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.R: Então eles foram a João e disseram: "Rabi, o senhor se lembra do homem que estava com o senhor a leste do rio Jordão? O senhor falou a todos sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está batizando as pessoas, e todo mundo está indo até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e não ao senhor!"

decisions.choice: they do not name Jesus: "this one"
decisions.reason: John's disciples speak of Jesus only as "the one who was with you" and "this one". Their words suggest rivalry: the one John pointed to now draws the crowds.

decisions.choice: testified: John's witness to Jesus in 1:29-34
decisions.reason: "Beyond the Jordan" is where John testified (1:28). His disciples remind him that he himself pointed to this man.

decisions.choice: everyone: an overstatement
decisions.reason: "All" is exaggerated in alarm; 3:32 says that no one accepts his testimony, an overstatement the other way.

decisions.choice: remember the man ...? You told everyone about him
alternatives: the one who was with you ..., to whom you testified
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long description into a question and a statement.

decisions.choice: instead
decisions.reason: Readable shows the complaint in their words (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: The pronouns refer to Jesus, so they take the deity_pronoun setting, even though the speakers do not yet see who he is.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}
decisions.reason: As in English: the stressed pronouns refer to Jesus, so they take the setting, even though the speakers do not yet see who he is. "Tú" is John and has none.

decisions.choice: en lugar de venir a ti
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable shows the complaint in their words (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: John's disciples call John "thầy" and speak of Jesus as "người ấy" / "ông ấy", with no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: "Ngài" with the setting, as the English keeps "him"/"Him"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese pronouns carry the speaker's attitude. These disciples avoid naming Jesus and see him as a rival to their teacher, so "Ngài" would put reverence in their mouths that the scene does not have; "ông ấy" is polite but neutral. "Thầy" (lowercase as a pronoun) is how disciples speak to their own teacher.

decisions.choice: John's disciples speak of Jesus as "그 사람" and "그", with no honorifics, while honouring John ("선생님께서")
decisions.reason: The Greek does not name Jesus ("this one"), and the disciples speak as John's followers troubled by a rival. Korean shows this through honorifics: John is honoured, Jesus is not. The narrator and John himself (3:28-35) speak of Jesus with "그분".

decisions.choice: o senhor (John's disciples to their teacher)
decisions.reason: Disciples speaking to their own teacher speak up to a superior, so Portuguese uses "o senhor" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); "você" would sound offhand. "Tu" is kept for Jesus and God.

source.text: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰωάννης καὶ εἶπεν· Οὐ δύναται ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνειν οὐδὲ ἓν ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Answered John and said, "Not is able a person to receive not even one [thing] unless it has been given to him from the heaven.

en.L: John answered and said, "{{gender:A person|A man}} is not able to receive even one thing unless it has been given to {{gender:them|him}} from heaven.
en.B: John replied, "No one can receive anything at all unless it has been given {{gender:them|him}} from heaven.
en.R: John answered, "{{gender:People|A man}} can have only what God gives {{gender:them|him}}.

es.L: Respondió Juan y dijo: «{{gender:Una persona|Un hombre}} no puede recibir ni una sola cosa si no le ha sido dada del cielo.
es.B: Juan respondió: «Nadie puede recibir nada si no le ha sido dado del cielo.
es.R: Juan les respondió: «Nadie puede tener nada que Dios no le haya dado.

fr.L: Jean répondit et dit : « {{gender:Un être humain|Un homme}} ne peut recevoir pas même une seule chose, si elle ne lui a pas été donnée du ciel.
fr.B: Jean répondit : « Personne ne peut rien recevoir, si cela ne lui est pas donné du ciel.
fr.R: Jean a répondu : « {{gender:Une personne|Un homme}} ne peut avoir que ce que Dieu lui donne.

sw.L: Yohana akajibu, akasema, "Mtu hawezi kupokea hata kitu kimoja isipokuwa amepewa kutoka mbinguni.
sw.B: Yohana akajibu, "Hakuna mtu awezaye kupokea chochote isipokuwa amepewa kutoka mbinguni.
sw.R: Yohana akajibu, "Mtu anaweza kuwa na kile tu ambacho Mungu humpa.

vi.L: Giăng đáp và nói: "Một người không thể nhận được dù chỉ một điều gì, nếu điều đó không được ban cho người ấy từ trời.
vi.B: Giăng đáp: "Không ai có thể nhận được gì cả, nếu điều đó không được ban cho từ trời.
vi.R: Giăng trả lời: "Người ta chỉ có được những gì Đức Chúa Trời ban cho.

ko.L: 요한이 대답하여 말했다. "사람은 하늘로부터 주어지지 않으면 아무것도 받을 수 없다.
ko.B: 요한이 대답했다. "하늘에서 주시지 않으면, 누구도 아무것도 받을 수 없다.
ko.R: 요한이 대답했다. "사람은 하나님께서 주시는 것만 가질 수 있다.

pt.L: João respondeu e disse: "{{gender:Uma pessoa|Um homem}} não pode receber nem uma só coisa, a não ser que lhe tenha sido dada do céu.
pt.B: João respondeu: "Ninguém pode receber coisa alguma, a não ser que lhe seja dada do céu.
pt.R: João respondeu: "{{gender:Uma pessoa|Um homem}} só pode ter aquilo que Deus lhe dá.

decisions.choice: from heaven: from God
decisions.reason: A reverent way of naming God, as in Mark 11:30 ("from heaven or from men?").

decisions.choice: a general rule that covers both Jesus and John
alternatives: it refers mainly to Jesus: his success is God's gift
it refers mainly to John: he cannot claim more than he was given
decisions.reason: The saying is general. It explains why the crowds go to Jesus (God has given them to him, compare 6:37, 65) and why John is content with his own smaller task (3:28-30). It may lean to either, but the wording allows both, so every level keeps it general.

decisions.choice: a person, anyone
decisions.reason: The word is general, so the gender setting applies.

decisions.choice: {{gender:A person|A man}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: Inclusive default; the traditional form one tap away.

decisions.choice: what God gives them
alternatives: unless it has been given from heaven
decisions.reason: Readable names God (meaning decision m1) and turns the double negative into a plain statement.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Una persona|Un hombre}} (L); nadie (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means anyone (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps the noun with the inclusive default; Balanced and Readable say "nadie", which is general without a setting.

decisions.choice: que Dios no le haya dado
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable names God (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:Un être humain|Un homme}} (L); {{gender:Une personne|Un homme}} (R); Personne (B)
decisions.reason: Anyone is meant (meaning decision m3): the inclusive default names a person plainly, with the traditional "un homme" as the alternative. Balanced says "personne" (no one), which is already inclusive, and "lui" (to him or her) does not mark gender, so Balanced needs no setting.

source.text: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς μοι μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι εἶπον· Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ χριστός, ἀλλ’ ὅτι Ἀπεσταλμένος εἰμὶ ἔμπροσθεν ἐκείνου.

records.literal_gloss: Yourselves you to me testify that I said, 'Not am I the Christ,' but that 'Sent I am before that one.'

en.L: You yourselves testify to me that I said, 'I am not the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}},' but that, 'I have been sent ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.'
en.B: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, 'I am not the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}; rather, I have been sent ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.'
en.R: You heard me say it yourselves: 'I am not the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}. God sent me to go ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.'

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos me son|Vosotros mismos me sois}} testigos de que dije: “Yo no soy el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}”, sino: “He sido enviado delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos son|Vosotros mismos sois}} testigos de que dije: “Yo no soy el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}; he sido enviado delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos me oyeron|Vosotros mismos me oísteis}} decir: “Yo no soy el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}. Dios me envió para ir delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}”.

fr.L: Vous-mêmes, vous m’êtes témoins que j’ai dit : “Moi, je ne suis pas le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}”, mais : “J’ai été envoyé devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.”
fr.B: Vous êtes vous-mêmes témoins que j’ai dit : “Ce n’est pas moi qui suis le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ; j’ai été envoyé devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.”
fr.R: Vous m’avez entendu le dire vous-mêmes : “Je ne suis pas le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Dieu m’a envoyé pour aller devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.”

sw.L: Ninyi wenyewe mnanishuhudia kwamba nilisema, 'Mimi siye {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}},' bali kwamba, 'Nimetumwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.'
sw.B: Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi wangu kwamba nilisema, 'Mimi siye {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}; ila nimetumwa nimtangulie.'
sw.R: Ninyi wenyewe mlinisikia nikisema: 'Mimi siye {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Mungu alinituma niende mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.'

vi.L: Chính các con làm chứng cho thầy rằng thầy đã nói: 'Tôi không phải là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}},' nhưng rằng: 'Tôi được sai đi trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.B: Chính các con là nhân chứng rằng thầy đã nói: 'Tôi không phải là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}; nhưng tôi được sai đi trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.R: Chính các con đã nghe thầy nói: 'Tôi không phải là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Đức Chúa Trời đã sai tôi đi trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'

ko.L: 너희 자신이, 내가 '나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니다'라고 말하고 '나는 그분보다 앞서 보냄을 받았다'라고 말한 것을 내게 증언한다.
ko.B: 너희가 직접 내 증인이다. 나는 '나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니다. 나는 그분보다 앞서 보냄을 받은 사람이다' 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 너희도 내가 하는 말을 직접 들었다. '나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}가 아니다. 하나님께서 나를 그분보다 먼저 보내셨다.'

pt.L: Vocês mesmos me são testemunhas de que eu disse: 'Eu não sou o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}', mas: 'Fui enviado adiante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.'
pt.B: Vocês mesmos são minhas testemunhas de que eu disse: 'Eu não sou o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}; fui enviado adiante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.'
pt.R: Vocês mesmos me ouviram dizer: 'Eu não sou o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}. Deus me enviou para ir na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.'

decisions.choice: John repeats what he said in 1:20-27
decisions.reason: "I am not the Christ" are John's words in 1:20, and his role as the one sent ahead takes up 1:23 and 1:30. His disciples heard him say it.

decisions.choice: the Christ: a title, the promised Anointed One
decisions.reason: As in 1:20: with the article it is a title, not a name.

decisions.choice: sent ahead of him: sent by God as a forerunner
decisions.reason: The passive points to God (1:6, 33). Malachi 3:1 speaks of a messenger sent to prepare the way before the Lord; John is the one who goes first, not the one who comes.

decisions.choice: the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: A title with the article, so every level writes "the" outside the span, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: God sent me
decisions.reason: Readable names the sender (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: A title with the article, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: Dios me envió
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable names the sender (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}
decisions.reason: As in 1:20: a title with the article (meaning decision m2), so every level writes "le" outside the span. Literal and Balanced repeat John's own words of 1:20 in the same French ("Moi, je ne suis pas", "Ce n'est pas moi qui suis").

decisions.choice: John calls himself "thầy" and his disciples "các con"; in his earlier words to the priests (1:20) he says "tôi"
decisions.reason: A Vietnamese teacher speaks to his own disciples as "thầy" and "các con". The quoted words were first said to the delegation from Jerusalem, to whom John said "tôi", so the quotation keeps "tôi".

decisions.choice: "Ngài" (with the setting) for Jesus in John's words
decisions.reason: Unlike his disciples, John speaks of Jesus with reverence as the one he was sent ahead of, so "Ngài" fits his words.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} with no word for "the"
decisions.reason: Korean has no article. "그리스도" and "메시아" both read as the title of the promised one in Korean, not as a name, so "I am not the Christ" needs nothing added; both forms take the same particle "가".

source.text: ὁ ἔχων τὴν νύμφην νυμφίος ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου ὁ ἑστηκὼς καὶ ἀκούων αὐτοῦ, χαρᾷ χαίρει διὰ τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ νυμφίου.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] having the bride bridegroom is; the now friend of the bridegroom, the [one] standing and hearing him, with joy rejoices because of the voice of the bridegroom.

en.L: The one who has the bride is [the] bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices with joy because of the bridegroom's voice.
en.B: It is the bridegroom who has the bride. But the bridegroom's friend, who stands by and listens for him, rejoices with great joy at the sound of the bridegroom's voice.
en.R: The bride is for the bridegroom. The bridegroom's friend stands nearby and listens for him, and when he hears the bridegroom's voice, his heart is full of joy.

es.L: El que tiene a la novia es [el] novio; pero el amigo del novio, que está [allí] y lo oye, se alegra con alegría por la voz del novio.
es.B: El que tiene a la novia es el novio. Pero el amigo del novio, que está a su lado y lo escucha, se llena de alegría al oír la voz del novio.
es.R: La novia es para el novio. El amigo del novio espera cerca y está atento a él, y cuando oye la voz del novio, se le llena el corazón de alegría.

fr.L: Celui qui a la mariée est [le] marié ; mais l’ami du marié, qui se tient là et l’entend, se réjouit de joie à cause de la voix du marié.
fr.B: C’est le marié qui a la mariée. Mais l’ami du marié, qui se tient près de lui et l’écoute, se réjouit d’une grande joie en entendant la voix du marié.
fr.R: La mariée est pour le marié. L’ami du marié se tient tout près et l’écoute, et quand il entend la voix du marié, son cœur est plein de joie.

sw.L: Aliye na bibi harusi ndiye bwana harusi; lakini rafiki wa bwana harusi, anayesimama na kumsikia, hufurahi kwa furaha kwa sababu ya sauti ya bwana harusi.
sw.B: Bwana harusi ndiye aliye na bibi harusi. Lakini rafiki wa bwana harusi, anayesimama karibu na kumsikiliza, hufurahi kwa furaha kuu anaposikia sauti ya bwana harusi.
sw.R: Bibi harusi ni wa bwana harusi. Rafiki wa bwana harusi husimama karibu na kumsikiliza, na anaposikia sauti ya bwana harusi, moyo wake hujaa furaha.

vi.L: Ai có cô dâu thì là chú rể; còn bạn của chú rể, người đứng [đó] và nghe chú rể, thì vui mừng hớn hở vì tiếng của chú rể.
vi.B: Chú rể là người cưới cô dâu. Còn bạn của chú rể, người đứng bên cạnh và lắng nghe chú rể, thì vui mừng khôn xiết khi nghe tiếng chú rể.
vi.R: Cô dâu thuộc về chú rể. Bạn của chú rể đứng gần đó lắng nghe, và khi nghe tiếng chú rể, lòng anh tràn đầy niềm vui.

ko.L: 신부를 가진 이는 신랑이다. 그러나 신랑의 친구, 곧 서서 그의 말을 듣는 이는 신랑의 음성 때문에 기쁨으로 기뻐한다.
ko.B: 신부를 맞는 사람은 신랑이다. 그러나 곁에 서서 신랑의 말을 기다리는 신랑의 친구는, 신랑의 목소리를 들으면 크게 기뻐한다.
ko.R: 신부는 신랑의 것이다. 신랑의 친구는 곁에 서서 신랑의 말을 기다린다. 그리고 신랑의 목소리가 들리면 마음이 기쁨으로 가득 찬다.

pt.L: Quem tem a noiva é [o] noivo; mas o amigo do noivo, que está ao lado e o ouve, alegra-se com alegria por causa da voz do noivo.
pt.B: Quem tem a noiva é o noivo. Mas o amigo do noivo, que fica ao lado esperando por ele, se alegra com grande alegria ao ouvir a voz do noivo.
pt.R: A noiva é do noivo. O amigo do noivo fica ali perto, esperando por ele, e, quando ouve a voz do noivo, o seu coração se enche de alegria.

decisions.choice: the friend of the bridegroom: the groom's close friend who helped him at the wedding
decisions.reason: At a Jewish wedding a close friend of the groom acted for him, helping to arrange the marriage and attending him at the feast. His part was to serve the groom, not to take the bride.

decisions.choice: the bridegroom and the bride: a picture of God and his people
decisions.reason: The prophets picture the LORD as Israel's husband (Isaiah 54:5; 62:4-5; Hosea 2:16-20). In the Gospels Jesus speaks of himself as the bridegroom (Mark 2:19-20), and Revelation calls God's people the bride of the Lamb (Revelation 21:2, 9). Here Jesus is the bridegroom, the people who come to him are the bride, and John is the friend.

decisions.choice: rejoices with joy: rejoices greatly
decisions.reason: Joining a verb to its own noun is a Hebrew way of adding force.

decisions.choice: stands and hears him: waits ready for the groom and listens to him
decisions.reason: The friend stands by to serve and is glad to hear the groom's voice, perhaps when the groom arrives to claim his bride.

decisions.choice: rejoices with joy (L); rejoices with great joy (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the doubled words; Balanced keeps the key term "joy" and shows the added force (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: him, with no deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: Within the picture the pronoun refers to the bridegroom of the story, not directly to Christ, so it is written plainly.

decisions.choice: The bride is for the bridegroom
alternatives: The one who has the bride is the bridegroom
decisions.reason: Readable says the point plainly: the bride belongs to the groom, not to his friend.

decisions.choice: se alegra con alegría (L); se llena de alegría (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the doubled words; Balanced keeps "alegría" and shows the added force (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in English: within the picture the pronouns refer to the bridegroom of the story, not directly to Christ.

decisions.choice: La novia es para el novio
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says the point plainly.

decisions.choice: le marié, la mariée, l'ami du marié
decisions.reason: The everyday words for a couple on their wedding day, as at Cana (2:9). "L'époux" and "l'épouse" are the older words in which the prophets' picture of God and his people is often read (meaning decision m2), but today they name a married couple rather than a wedding, and the picture is of the wedding itself. As in English, the pronouns for the groom take no deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "chú rể" repeated for "him"
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun keeps the picture clear and avoids choosing a pronoun for a figure who stands for Jesus.

source.text: αὕτη οὖν ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ πεπλήρωται.

records.literal_gloss: This therefore the joy the mine has been fulfilled.

en.L: So this joy of mine has been fulfilled.
en.B: This, then, is my joy, and it has been made complete.
en.R: That is the joy I have, and now it is complete.

es.L: Así pues, esta alegría mía ha sido colmada.
es.B: Esa es mi alegría, y ya es completa.
es.R: Esa es la alegría que tengo, y ahora es completa.

fr.L: Cette joie donc, qui est la mienne, a été rendue pleine.
fr.B: Telle est donc ma joie, et elle est maintenant complète.
fr.R: C’est la joie que j’ai, et maintenant elle est complète.

sw.L: Basi furaha hii yangu imetimizwa.
sw.B: Basi hii ndiyo furaha yangu, nayo imekamilika.
sw.R: Hiyo ndiyo furaha niliyo nayo, na sasa imekamilika.

vi.L: Vậy niềm vui này của thầy đã được trọn vẹn.
vi.B: Đó chính là niềm vui của thầy, và niềm vui ấy nay đã trọn vẹn.
vi.R: Thầy cũng có niềm vui như thế, và bây giờ niềm vui ấy đã trọn vẹn.

ko.L: 그러므로 나의 이 기쁨이 가득 채워졌다.
ko.B: 이것이 바로 내 기쁨이며, 이제 그 기쁨이 가득 찼다.
ko.R: 내 기쁨이 바로 그런 것이다. 그리고 이제 그 기쁨이 다 채워졌다.

pt.L: Assim, esta alegria, a minha, se completou.
pt.B: Esta, então, é a minha alegria, e ela está completa.
pt.R: Essa é a alegria que eu tenho, e agora ela está completa.

decisions.choice: has been fulfilled: made full and stays full
decisions.reason: The perfect passive says John's joy has reached its fullness and remains so. Jesus uses the same words of his disciples' joy (15:11; 16:24; 17:13).

decisions.choice: John's joy is that people are coming to Jesus
decisions.reason: What troubled his disciples (3:26) is the very thing that makes John glad: the bride is going to the bridegroom.

source.text: ἐκεῖνον δεῖ αὐξάνειν, ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: That one it is necessary to increase, me but to decrease.

en.L: That one must increase, but I must decrease.
en.B: He must grow greater, but I must grow less.
en.R: He must become more and more important, while I become less and less.

es.L: Es necesario que aquel crezca, pero que yo disminuya.
es.B: Él tiene que crecer, y yo tengo que menguar.
es.R: Él tiene que ser cada vez más importante, y yo cada vez menos.

fr.L: Il faut que celui-là grandisse, mais que moi, je diminue.
fr.B: Lui, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} doit croître ; moi, je dois décroître.
fr.R: Lui doit devenir de plus en plus important, et moi de moins en moins.

sw.L: Yule inampasa kuongezeka, lakini mimi kupungua.
sw.B: Yeye lazima azidi kuwa mkuu, lakini mimi nipungue.
sw.R: Yeye anapaswa kuwa mkuu zaidi na zaidi, nami nizidi kuwa mdogo.

vi.L: Ngài phải gia tăng, còn thầy phải giảm đi.
vi.B: Ngài phải ngày càng lớn lên, còn thầy phải nhỏ lại.
vi.R: Ngài phải ngày càng quan trọng hơn, còn thầy thì ngày càng ít quan trọng đi.

ko.L: 그분은 커지셔야 하고, 나는 작아져야 한다.
ko.B: 그분은 점점 커지셔야 하고, 나는 점점 작아져야 한다.
ko.R: 그분은 점점 더 높아지셔야 하고, 나는 점점 더 낮아져야 한다.

pt.L: É preciso que aquele cresça, mas que eu diminua.
pt.B: Ele deve crescer, e eu devo diminuir.
pt.R: Ele precisa ficar cada vez mais importante, e eu, cada vez menos.

decisions.choice: must: what God's purpose requires
decisions.reason: The same word as in 3:7 and 3:14. John accepts his lessening as part of God's plan, not as a loss to resent.

decisions.choice: increase, decrease: grow in honor and following, and grow less
decisions.reason: The verbs describe growth and shrinking; here they apply to standing among the people. John's whole testimony points away from himself to Jesus (1:20, 27, 30).

decisions.choice: He
decisions.reason: English uses a plain pronoun; at the start of a sentence it is capitalized either way.

decisions.choice: become more and more important ... less and less
decisions.reason: Readable says what the increase and decrease are (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: cada vez más importante ... cada vez menos
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says what the increase and decrease are (meaning decision m2). "Él" begins the sentence and is written plain.

decisions.choice: John speaks of Jesus as "그분" with the honorific "-시-" (3:28-35)
decisions.reason: John knows who Jesus is and gives way to him, so Korean lets him honour Jesus, unlike his disciples in 3:26. He speaks to his own disciples in the plain style.

source.text: Ὁ ἄνωθεν ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] from above coming above all is.

en.L: The one who comes from above is above all.
en.B: The one who comes from above is greater than all.
en.R: The one who comes from above is greater than everyone.

es.L: El que viene de lo alto está sobre todos.
es.B: El que viene de lo alto es superior a todos.
es.R: El que viene de lo alto es más importante que todos.

fr.L: Celui qui vient d’en haut est au-dessus de tous.
fr.B: Celui qui vient d’en haut est plus grand que tous.
fr.R: Celui qui vient d’en haut est plus grand que tout le monde.

sw.L: Anayekuja kutoka juu yuko juu ya wote.
sw.B: Anayekuja kutoka juu ni mkuu kuliko wote.
sw.R: Yule anayekuja kutoka juu ni mkuu kuliko kila mtu.

vi.L: Đấng từ trên cao đến thì ở trên tất cả.
vi.B: Đấng từ trên cao đến thì cao trọng hơn tất cả.
vi.R: Đấng từ trên cao đến thì lớn hơn mọi người.

ko.L: 위로부터 오시는 분은 모든 것 위에 계신다.
ko.B: 위에서 오시는 분은 모든 것보다 크시다.
ko.R: 위에서 오시는 분은 그 누구보다도 크시다.

pt.L: Aquele que vem do alto está acima de todos.
pt.B: Aquele que vem do alto é maior do que todos.
pt.R: Aquele que vem do alto é maior do que todo mundo.

decisions.choice: John the Baptist's words continue to the end of 3:36
alternatives: John's words end at 3:30, and 3:31-36 is the evangelist's own reflection
3:31-36 are words of Jesus, moved from elsewhere
decisions.reason: The manuscripts have no quotation marks. Nothing in the text marks a new speaker, and 3:31 explains why "he must increase": he comes from above. On the other side, the speech moves from "I" to statements about the one from heaven, and the language is close to Jesus's own in 3:11-13 and to the evangelist's in 3:16-21. Every level keeps the quotation open to 3:36, as with 3:16-21; the footnote gives the other view.

decisions.choice: from above: from heaven, as the next sentence says
decisions.reason: This is ἄνωθεν, the word of 3:3 and 3:7. Here it can only mean "from above"; it shows the sense the word has had in the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: above all: over all people, and over all things
decisions.reason: "All" may be people (set against "the one from the earth") or all things (compare 3:35). Both are true.

decisions.choice: greater than all (B); greater than everyone (R)
decisions.reason: "Above all" can be heard as "most of all"; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: todos
decisions.reason: Spanish must choose between "todos" (all people) and "todo" (all things), where the Greek may mean either (meaning decision m3). "Todos" follows the contrast with "the one from the earth" in the next sentence, as the English Readable does. "De lo alto" is the phrase of 3:3 and 3:7.

decisions.choice: d'en haut, as in 3:3 and 3:7
decisions.reason: The same word as in 3:3 and 3:7; here it can only mean "from above" (meaning decision m2). Every level keeps "d'en haut", the phrase of those verses, so the link stays visible; the next sentence says "du ciel".

source.text: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς λαλεῖ· ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν·

records.literal_gloss: The [one] being from the earth from the earth is and from the earth speaks; the [one] from the heaven coming above all is;

en.L: The one who is from the earth is from the earth and speaks from the earth; the one who comes from heaven is above all.
en.B: Whoever is from the earth is earthly and speaks from an earthly point of view. The one who comes from heaven is greater than all.
en.R: Anyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as someone from the earth. But the one who comes from heaven is greater than everyone.

es.L: El que es de la tierra, de la tierra es y de la tierra habla; el que viene del cielo está sobre todos.
es.B: El que es de la tierra es terrenal y habla como alguien de la tierra. El que viene del cielo es superior a todos.
es.R: El que viene de la tierra pertenece a la tierra y habla como alguien de la tierra. Pero el que viene del cielo es más importante que todos.

fr.L: Celui qui est de la terre est de la terre, et il parle à partir de la terre ; celui qui vient du ciel est au-dessus de tous.
fr.B: Celui qui est de la terre appartient à la terre et parle d’un point de vue terrestre. Celui qui vient du ciel est plus grand que tous.
fr.R: Celui qui vient de la terre appartient à la terre et parle comme quelqu’un de la terre. Mais celui qui vient du ciel est plus grand que tout le monde.

sw.L: Aliye wa dunia ni wa dunia, naye husema ya dunia; anayekuja kutoka mbinguni yuko juu ya wote.
sw.B: Aliye wa dunia ni wa kidunia, naye husema kwa mtazamo wa kidunia. Anayekuja kutoka mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko wote.
sw.R: Yeyote anayetoka duniani ni wa dunia, naye huzungumza kama mtu wa dunia. Lakini yule anayekuja kutoka mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko kila mtu.

vi.L: Người từ đất thì thuộc về đất và nói từ đất; Đấng từ trời đến thì ở trên tất cả;
vi.B: Ai từ đất mà ra thì thuộc về đất và nói theo cách nhìn của người trần. Đấng từ trời đến thì cao trọng hơn tất cả.
vi.R: Ai đến từ đất thì thuộc về đất và nói như người thuộc về đất. Nhưng Đấng từ trời đến thì lớn hơn mọi người.

ko.L: 땅에 속한 이는 땅에 속해 있고 땅에 속한 것을 말한다. 하늘로부터 오시는 분은 모든 것 위에 계신다.
ko.B: 땅에서 난 사람은 땅의 사람이어서 땅의 관점에서 말한다. 하늘에서 오시는 분은 모든 것보다 크시다.
ko.R: 땅에서 온 사람은 땅에 속해 있어서, 땅에 속한 사람처럼 말한다. 그러나 하늘에서 오시는 분은 그 누구보다도 크시다.

pt.L: Quem é da terra é da terra e fala da terra; aquele que vem do céu está acima de todos.
pt.B: Quem é da terra é terreno e fala do ponto de vista da terra. Aquele que vem do céu é maior do que todos.
pt.R: Quem vem da terra pertence à terra e fala como alguém da terra. Mas aquele que vem do céu é maior do que todo mundo.

alignments.target_span: from an earthly point of view

decisions.choice: the one from the earth: any merely human messenger, John included
decisions.reason: The contrast is about origin, not truth: John is from the earth and speaks as a man of the earth, though he was sent by God (1:6). The one from heaven speaks of what he has seen there (3:32).

decisions.choice: the second "is above all" (SBLGNT)
alternatives: without it: the one who comes from heaven testifies to what he has seen and heard (some early manuscripts)
decisions.reason: Some early witnesses, among them the first hand of Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Bezae, leave out the repeated "is above all" and join the clause to 3:32. The meaning is much the same, so no footnote. A reviewer should check this note against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: speaks from an earthly point of view
decisions.reason: Says what speaking "from the earth" means (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: greater than all / everyone
decisions.reason: As in the previous sentence.

decisions.choice: habla como alguien de la tierra
decisions.reason: As in English: says what speaking "from the earth" means (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: parle à partir de la terre
decisions.reason: "Parler de la terre" would mean speaking about the earth; the Greek means speaking as one who comes from it (meaning decision m1), so Literal says "à partir de".
