source.text: ὃ ἑώρακεν καὶ ἤκουσεν τοῦτο μαρτυρεῖ, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτοῦ οὐδεὶς λαμβάνει.

records.literal_gloss: What he has seen and heard, this he testifies, and the testimony of him no one receives.

en.L: What {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has seen and heard, this {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} testifies, and no one receives {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimony.
en.B: What {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has seen and heard is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bears witness to, but no one accepts {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimony.
en.R: He tells what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has seen and heard, but no one accepts what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says.

es.L: Lo que ha visto y oído, eso testifica, y nadie recibe {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} testimonio.
es.B: Da testimonio de lo que ha visto y oído, pero nadie acepta {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} testimonio.
es.R: Cuenta lo que ha visto y oído, pero nadie acepta lo que dice.

fr.L: Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu et entendu, de cela {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend témoignage, et personne ne reçoit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} témoignage.
fr.B: Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu et entendu, c’est de cela qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend témoignage, mais personne ne reçoit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} témoignage.
fr.R: Il raconte ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu et entendu, mais personne n’accepte ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit.

sw.L: Alichokiona na kukisikia, ndicho anachokishuhudia, wala hakuna anayeupokea ushuhuda {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Yeye hushuhudia yale aliyoyaona na kuyasikia, lakini hakuna anayeukubali ushuhuda {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Anaeleza yale aliyoyaona na kuyasikia, lakini hakuna anayekubali anachokisema.

vi.L: Điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thấy và đã nghe, điều ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm chứng, và không ai nhận lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài làm chứng về những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thấy và đã nghe, nhưng không ai chịu nhận lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài nói ra những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thấy và nghe, nhưng không ai chấp nhận lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói.

ko.L: 그분은 보시고 들으신 것, 그것을 증언하시는데, 아무도 그분의 증언을 받아들이지 않는다.
ko.B: 그분은 친히 보고 들으신 것을 증언하시지만, 아무도 그분의 증언을 받아들이지 않는다.
ko.R: 그분은 보고 들으신 것을 말씀하신다. 그런데 아무도 그분의 말씀을 받아들이지 않는다.

pt.L: O que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu e ouviu, isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} testemunha, e ninguém recebe o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} testemunho.
pt.B: O que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu e ouviu é o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} testemunha, mas ninguém aceita o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} testemunho.
pt.R: Ele conta o que viu e ouviu, mas ninguém aceita o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz.

decisions.choice: he speaks from what he has seen and heard with the Father
decisions.reason: The one from heaven is an eyewitness of God (1:18; 3:11; 8:26, 38). His witness is firsthand.

decisions.choice: no one: hardly anyone, an overstatement
decisions.reason: Like "his own did not receive him" (1:11), this is a sweeping statement; the next verse speaks of those who do receive it (compare 1:12).

decisions.choice: testimony, receive: as in 3:11
bears witness to
decisions.reason: Varies the verb so that "testimony" can follow; the Greek words are related.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} (L, B); no pronoun for him (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, so the only pronoun for Christ is the possessive "su", which takes the deity_pronoun setting under the book-wide rule (John 1:1). Readable says "lo que dice" and has no pronoun for him.

source.text: ὁ λαβὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐσφράγισεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀληθής ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] having received his the testimony has sealed that the God true is.

en.L: The one who has received {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimony has sealed [the fact] that God is true.
en.B: Anyone who accepts {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimony has put {{gender:their|his}} seal on this: God is true.
en.R: But those who do accept what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says confirm that God is true to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word.

es.L: El que ha recibido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} testimonio ha sellado [el hecho de] que Dios es veraz.
es.B: Quien acepta {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} testimonio pone su sello a esto: Dios es veraz.
es.R: Pero los que sí aceptan lo que dice confirman que Dios dice la verdad.

fr.L: Celui qui a reçu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} témoignage a scellé [le fait] que Dieu est véridique.
fr.B: Celui qui reçoit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} témoignage y appose son propre sceau : Dieu est véridique.
fr.R: Mais ceux qui acceptent ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit confirment que Dieu est fidèle à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole.

sw.L: Aliyeupokea ushuhuda {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ametia muhuri [kuthibitisha] kwamba Mungu ni wa kweli.
sw.B: Yeyote anayeukubali ushuhuda {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ametia muhuri juu ya jambo hili: Mungu ni wa kweli.
sw.R: Lakini wale wanaokubali anachosema wanathibitisha kwamba Mungu ni mwaminifu kwa neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

vi.L: Ai đã nhận lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì đã đóng ấn [xác nhận] rằng Đức Chúa Trời là chân thật.
vi.B: Ai nhận lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì đóng ấn xác nhận điều này: Đức Chúa Trời là chân thật.
vi.R: Nhưng ai chấp nhận lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói thì xác nhận rằng Đức Chúa Trời luôn nói thật.

ko.L: 그분의 증언을 받아들인 사람은 하나님께서 참되시다는 것에 도장을 찍었다.
ko.B: 그분의 증언을 받아들이는 사람은 하나님께서 참되시다는 것에 자기 도장을 찍은 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그분의 말씀을 받아들이는 사람은, 하나님께서 하신 말씀이 참되다는 것을 확인해 준다.

pt.L: Quem recebeu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} testemunho selou [o fato de] que Deus é verdadeiro.
pt.B: Quem aceita o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} testemunho confirma com o próprio selo que Deus é verdadeiro.
pt.R: Mas quem aceita o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz confirma que Deus é fiel à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra.

decisions.choice: set a seal: confirm as genuine
decisions.reason: A seal pressed on a document showed that it was authentic and agreed to (1 Kings 21:8; Esther 8:8; Jeremiah 32:10). To accept the testimony is to put one's own seal to it.

decisions.choice: accepting the Son's words means affirming that God speaks truly
decisions.reason: The one God sent speaks God's own words (the next verse), so whoever accepts them declares that God is true; refusing them treats God as a liar (1 John 5:10).

decisions.choice: true: truthful, reliable
decisions.reason: The adjective describes one whose word can be trusted.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone; inclusive default. Literal needs no pronoun and Readable uses the plural.

decisions.choice: has sealed [the fact] that
alternatives: has set his seal to this
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the single verb and brackets the object English needs.

decisions.choice: But those who do accept ... confirm that God is true to his word
alternatives: has set his seal that God is true
decisions.reason: Readable explains the image of the seal (meaning decision m1) and the sense of "true" (m3), and shows the contrast with the previous sentence.

decisions.choice: ha sellado [el hecho de] que
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal keeps the single verb and brackets the object Spanish needs.

decisions.choice: confirman que Dios dice la verdad
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable explains the seal (meaning decision m1) and the sense of "veraz" (m3), and shows the contrast with the previous sentence. Spanish needs no gender setting here.

decisions.choice: véridique (L, B); fidèle à sa parole (R)
decisions.reason: French "Dieu est vrai" could be read as "God is real". The adjective here means truthful, one whose word can be trusted (meaning decision m3), which "véridique" says; Readable puts it in everyday words. In Balanced "son propre sceau" is the believer's seal, so it takes no setting.

decisions.choice: "도장을 찍다"
decisions.reason: Setting one's seal on something is a Korean way of confirming it too: a document is made valid with one's own 도장. "인치다" is the older church word and is archaic today.

source.text: ὃν γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ λαλεῖ, οὐ γὰρ ἐκ μέτρου δίδωσιν τὸ πνεῦμα.

records.literal_gloss: Whom for sent the God the words of the God he speaks, not for from measure he gives the Spirit.

en.L: For the one whom God sent speaks the words of God, for not by measure does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give the Spirit.
en.B: For the one God sent speaks the words of God, since the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives is not measured out.
en.R: The one God sent speaks God's words, because the Spirit is given without any limit.

es.L: Porque aquel a quien Dios envió habla las palabras de Dios, pues no da el Espíritu por medida.
es.B: Porque el que Dios envió dice las palabras de Dios, ya que da el Espíritu sin medida.
es.R: El que Dios envió dice las palabras de Dios, porque el Espíritu se da sin ningún límite.

fr.L: Car celui que Dieu a envoyé dit les paroles de Dieu, car ce n’est pas avec mesure qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne l’Esprit.
fr.B: Car celui que Dieu a envoyé dit les paroles de Dieu, puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne l’Esprit sans compter.
fr.R: Celui que Dieu a envoyé dit les paroles de Dieu, parce que l’Esprit est donné sans aucune limite.

sw.L: Kwa maana yule ambaye Mungu alimtuma huyanena maneno ya Mungu, kwa maana hamtoi Roho kwa kipimo.
sw.B: Kwa maana yule aliyetumwa na Mungu husema maneno ya Mungu, kwa kuwa hamtoi Roho kwa kupima.
sw.R: Yule ambaye Mungu alimtuma huzungumza maneno ya Mungu, kwa sababu Roho hutolewa bila kikomo chochote.

vi.L: Vì Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã sai thì nói những lời của Đức Chúa Trời, vì không phải theo mức lường mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Vì Đấng Đức Chúa Trời sai đến thì nói lời của Đức Chúa Trời, bởi Thánh Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho không hề bị đong lường.
vi.R: Đấng Đức Chúa Trời sai đến nói lời của Đức Chúa Trời, vì Thánh Linh được ban cho Đấng ấy không có giới hạn nào.

ko.L: 하나님께서 보내신 분은 하나님의 말씀들을 말씀하시기 때문이다. 그분께서 성령을 재어서 주시지 않기 때문이다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 보내신 분은 하나님의 말씀을 전하신다. 그분께서 성령을 한없이 주시기 때문이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 보내신 분은 하나님의 말씀을 전하신다. 성령이 아무 제한 없이 주어지기 때문이다.

pt.L: Pois aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus, pois não é por medida que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá o Espírito.
pt.B: Pois aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus, já que o Espírito que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá não é medido.
pt.R: Aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus, porque o Espírito é dado sem limite nenhum.

decisions.choice: who gives the Spirit is not stated: most likely God gives the Spirit to the Son without limit
alternatives: the Son gives the Spirit to believers without limit
God gives the Spirit to believers without limit
decisions.reason: The verb has no subject. The nearest subject is God, and the next verse says the Father has given all things into the Son's hand; the Spirit came down on Jesus and remained (1:32-33; Isaiah 11:2). This explains why he speaks God's words. Many later manuscripts add "God" as the subject. On the other side, the present tense "gives" can describe Jesus, who baptizes with the Spirit and gives the Spirit (1:33; 7:39; 20:22). Every level keeps the open wording; the footnote gives both readings.

decisions.choice: the Spirit: the Holy Spirit
the one God sent: the Son, who speaks God's words
decisions.reason: John often calls Jesus the one the Father sent (3:17; 5:36-38), and Jesus says his teaching is not his own but the Father's (7:16; 12:49; 14:10).

decisions.choice: not by measure: without limit, not rationed out
decisions.reason: A measure was a fixed amount; the Spirit is given in full.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: The giver is God or the Son (meaning decision m1); either way the pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: the Spirit is given without any limit
alternatives: he gives the Spirit without measure
decisions.reason: Readable uses the passive, so that like the Greek it does not name the giver, and avoids a "he" young readers might take one way only.

decisions.choice: da, with no stated subject
decisions.reason: Spanish, like the Greek, can leave the giver unnamed in the verb, so Literal and Balanced keep the open question of meaning decision m1 without a pronoun. Readable uses the impersonal "se da", as English uses the passive.

decisions.choice: sans compter
decisions.reason: "Sans compter" is the everyday French for giving without holding back, which is what "not by measure" means (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps the measure ("avec mesure"). As in the English, "il" may be God or the Son (m1) and takes the deity_pronoun setting either way.

source.text: ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν υἱόν, καὶ πάντα δέδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The Father loves the Son, and all things has given into the hand of him.

en.L: The Father loves the Son, and all things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand.
en.B: The Father loves the Son and has handed everything over to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: The Father loves the Son and has given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} power over everything.

es.L: El Padre ama al Hijo, y todas las cosas ha entregado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano.
es.B: El Padre ama al Hijo y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha entregado todo.
es.R: El Padre ama al Hijo y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado poder sobre todas las cosas.

fr.L: Le Père aime le Fils, et toutes choses, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a données dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main.
fr.B: Le Père aime le Fils et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a tout confié.
fr.R: Le Père aime le Fils et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné le pouvoir sur tout.

sw.L: Baba anampenda Mwana, na amempa vitu vyote mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.B: Baba anampenda Mwana, na amemkabidhi kila kitu.
sw.R: Baba anampenda Mwana, na amempa mamlaka juu ya kila kitu.

vi.L: Cha yêu Con, và đã giao mọi sự vào tay Con.
vi.B: Cha yêu Con và đã giao phó mọi sự cho Con.
vi.R: Cha yêu Con và đã ban cho Con quyền trên mọi sự.

ko.L: 아버지께서는 아들을 사랑하시고, 모든 것을 그의 손에 주셨다.
ko.B: 아버지께서는 아들을 사랑하시고, 모든 것을 아들의 손에 맡기셨다.
ko.R: 아버지께서는 아들을 사랑하신다. 그리고 모든 것을 다스릴 권한을 아들에게 주셨다.

pt.L: O Pai ama o Filho, e todas as coisas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregou na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão.
pt.B: O Pai ama o Filho e {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} entregou tudo.
pt.R: O Pai ama o Filho e deu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} poder sobre todas as coisas.

decisions.choice: the Father's love for the Son
decisions.reason: John uses both verbs for love of the Father's love for the Son (here and 5:20); see the note on the book's terms. This love is the ground of all the Son has (17:24).

decisions.choice: into his hand: under his authority and care
decisions.reason: To give something into someone's hand is to put it in their power (13:3; 17:2; compare Matthew 28:18).

decisions.choice: has given: the gift stands
decisions.reason: The perfect tense describes a gift made and still in force.

decisions.choice: has handed everything over to him
alternatives: has given all things into his hand
decisions.reason: Plain wording for the idiom (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: has given him power over everything
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: le ha entregado todo (B); le ha dado poder sobre todas las cosas (R)
decisions.reason: Plain wording for the idiom (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: lui a tout confié
alternatives: a tout remis entre ses mains
decisions.reason: To give something into someone's hand is to put it under his authority and care (meaning decision m2); "confier" says both in one plain word. Literal keeps the hand ("dans sa main").

decisions.choice: "tay Con" for "his hand"
decisions.reason: With "Ngài" Vietnamese could not show whether the hand is the Father's or the Son's; the Greek pronoun points to the Son, so the noun is repeated.

source.text: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον· ὁ δὲ ἀπειθῶν τῷ υἱῷ οὐκ ὄψεται ζωήν, ἀλλ’ ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] believing in the Son has life eternal; the [one] but disobeying the Son not will see life, but the wrath of the God remains on him.

en.L: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who disobeys the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on {{gender:them|him}}."
en.B: Anyone who believes in the Son has eternal life, but anyone who refuses to obey the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on {{gender:them|him}}."
en.R: Anyone who believes in the Son has eternal life already. But anyone who does not obey the Son will not have that life. Instead, God's anger remains on {{gender:them|him}}."

es.L: El que cree en el Hijo tiene vida eterna; pero el que desobedece al Hijo no verá vida, sino que la ira de Dios permanece sobre {{gender:esa persona|él}}».
es.B: El que cree en el Hijo tiene vida eterna, pero el que se niega a obedecer al Hijo no verá la vida. Al contrario, la ira de Dios permanece sobre {{gender:esa persona|él}}».
es.R: Quien cree en el Hijo ya tiene vida eterna. Pero quien no obedece al Hijo no tendrá esa vida. Al contrario, el enojo de Dios permanece sobre esa persona».

fr.L: Celui qui croit dans le Fils a la vie éternelle ; mais celui qui désobéit au Fils ne verra pas la vie, mais la colère de Dieu demeure sur lui. »
fr.B: Quiconque croit au Fils possède la vie éternelle, mais quiconque refuse d’obéir au Fils ne verra pas la vie : au contraire, la colère de Dieu demeure sur lui. »
fr.R: Celui qui croit au Fils a déjà la vie éternelle. Mais celui qui n’obéit pas au Fils n’aura pas cette vie. Au contraire, la colère de Dieu reste sur lui. »

sw.L: Yule anayemwamini Mwana anao uzima wa milele; lakini yule asiyemtii Mwana hatauona uzima, bali ghadhabu ya Mungu inakaa juu yake."
sw.B: Kila anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele, lakini anayekataa kumtii Mwana hatauona uzima. Badala yake, ghadhabu ya Mungu inakaa juu yake."
sw.R: Kila anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele tayari. Lakini asiyemtii Mwana hatapata uzima huo. Badala yake, hasira ya Mungu inakaa juu yake."

vi.L: Ai tin vào Con thì có sự sống đời đời; còn ai không vâng phục Con sẽ không thấy sự sống, nhưng cơn thịnh nộ của Đức Chúa Trời ở lại trên người ấy."
vi.B: Ai tin vào Con thì có sự sống đời đời, còn ai không chịu vâng phục Con thì sẽ không được thấy sự sống. Trái lại, cơn thịnh nộ của Đức Chúa Trời vẫn còn đè nặng trên người ấy."
vi.R: Ai tin vào Con thì đã có sự sống đời đời rồi. Nhưng ai không vâng lời Con thì sẽ không có được sự sống ấy. Trái lại, cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời vẫn ở lại trên người ấy."

ko.L: 아들을 믿는 사람은 영원한 생명을 가지고 있다. 그러나 아들에게 순종하지 않는 사람은 생명을 보지 못할 것이고, 오히려 하나님의 진노가 그 사람 위에 머물러 있다."
ko.B: 아들을 믿는 사람에게는 영원한 생명이 있다. 그러나 아들에게 순종하기를 거부하는 사람은 생명을 보지 못하고, 오히려 하나님의 진노가 그 사람 위에 머물러 있다."
ko.R: 아들을 믿는 사람은 이미 영원한 생명을 가지고 있다. 그러나 아들에게 순종하지 않는 사람은 그 생명을 얻지 못한다. 오히려 하나님의 노여움이 그 사람 위에 그대로 머물러 있다."

pt.L: Quem crê no Filho tem vida eterna; mas quem desobedece ao Filho não verá a vida, mas a ira de Deus permanece sobre ele."
pt.B: Quem crê no Filho tem a vida eterna, mas quem se recusa a obedecer ao Filho não verá a vida. Pelo contrário, a ira de Deus permanece sobre ele."
pt.R: Quem acredita no Filho já tem a vida eterna. Mas quem não obedece ao Filho não vai ter essa vida. Pelo contrário, a ira de Deus continua sobre ele."

decisions.choice: disobey, refuse to obey: the opposite of believing
decisions.reason: ἀπειθῶν means to disobey or refuse to be persuaded. John sets it against "believes": not believing the Son is disobeying him, refusing the claim God makes through him. The sense includes unbelief, and it has often been rendered "does not believe"; the footnote gives that.

decisions.choice: has: eternal life is a present possession
decisions.reason: Key term. The believer already has eternal life (5:24); compare 3:18, where the unbeliever is already judged.

decisions.choice: see life: experience it, share in it
decisions.reason: As "see the kingdom of God" in 3:3.

decisions.choice: the wrath of God: God's settled opposition to evil and his judgment on it
decisions.reason: The word is used only here in John. It is not a sudden temper but God's just response to the refusal of his Son (Romans 1:18).

decisions.choice: remains: it is already on them and stays
decisions.reason: The present tense matches "already judged" in 3:18. μένει is John's word "remain"; the one who believes is taken out from under the wrath, and the one who refuses stays under it.

decisions.choice: disobeys (L); refuses to obey (B); does not obey (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the sense of obeying (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: remains
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for John: "remain" for this verb in its weighty sense.

decisions.choice: God's anger
decisions.reason: "Wrath" is an uncommon word for young readers; "anger" is the plain word, explained in meaning decision m4.

decisions.choice: already; will not have that life
alternatives: has eternal life; will not see life
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the life is present now (meaning decision m2) and gives the sense of "see" (m3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone who refuses; inclusive default.

decisions.choice: desobedece (L); se niega a obedecer (B); no obedece (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: every level keeps the sense of obeying (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: permanece
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "permanecer" for this verb in its weighty sense, as in 1:32-33.

decisions.choice: el enojo de Dios (R); la ira (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in English: "ira" is less common for young readers; meaning decision m4 explains it.

decisions.choice: {{gender:esa persona|él}}
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone who refuses: inclusive default, with the generic "él" one tap away. Readable says "esa persona" plainly.

decisions.choice: la colère de Dieu, at every level
decisions.reason: "Colère" is the plain French word, so Readable needs no change where the English moves from "wrath" to "anger"; "courroux" is literary. Meaning decision m4 says what it is.

decisions.choice: reste (R); demeure (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 1:32: "demeurer" is the word for this verb in its weighty sense and keeps the link with the rest of John (meaning decision m5); for young readers it is literary, so Readable says "rester", which carries the same sense.

decisions.choice: ghadhabu (L, B), hasira (R); inakaa
decisions.reason: "Ghadhabu" is settled, righteous anger, the sense in the meaning note; Readable says "hasira" (anger), as the English Readable says "God's anger". μένει is "kukaa", the verb used for the Spirit remaining on Jesus (1:32-33) and for staying with him (1:38-39), so Swahili keeps John's word.

decisions.choice: "진노" (L, B); "노여움" (R)
decisions.reason: "진노" is God's settled anger against evil, the established Korean word; "분노" and "화" sound like a passing human temper. Readable uses the native "노여움", which keeps the weight while being plainer.

decisions.choice: a ira de Deus continua sobre ele
alternatives: a ira de Deus permanece sobre ele
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "anger" because "wrath" is rare in English; Portuguese "ira" is understood by young readers, while "raiva" sounds like a temper, which meaning decision m4 rules out. Readable says "continua" for the plain sense "stays"; Literal and Balanced keep "permanece", John's word.
